# Midnight.Passport.Semantics

Attaches semantics to the architecture diagram via the standard *free category +
interpretation functors* recipe:

* **`C_arch`** — the free strict symmetric monoidal category generated by the
  channels `ArchChan` (objects) and the boxes `ArchBox` (morphisms) of the
  architecture. `architectureᶜ` is the architecture rebuilt in this category.
* **Syntax functor** `syn : C_arch → FMTerm` — the object-generator map
  `chanName : ArchChan → String` together with `synBox`, which sends each box to
  its named `gen`. Because the objects differ (`ArchChan` vs `String`), `syn`
  transports along `chanName`; it recovers the `architecture` term verbatim.
* **Semantics generator data** — each channel to a `Channel` and each `ArchBox`
  to a `Machine`. By the universal property of the free SMC this data *induces* a
  symmetric monoidal functor `C_arch → Machine` once the Machine category is
  packaged as such.

The diagram below is the image of `architectureᶜ` under the syntax functor
(`architectureˢ`); it is rendered straight from that term — compiled to Graphviz
DOT and laid out by `dot` — so it cannot drift from the definitions on this page.

```agda
module Midnight.Passport.Semantics where

open import Data.String using (String)
open import Data.List   using (List; []; _∷_; map; _++_)
open import Data.List.Properties using (map-++)
open import Data.Unit   using (⊤)
open import Relation.Binary.PropositionalEquality using (_≡_; refl)

open import Categories.FreeMonoidal using (Symm; _≤_; v≤v)
import Categories.FreeStrictMonoidal as FSM

import Midnight.Passport.FMTerm as FM

import CategoricalCrypto.Channel.Core as Ch
import CategoricalCrypto.Machine.Core as Mc
```

## 1. Object generators: the architecture's channels

The objects of `C_arch` are freely generated by the channel names, enumerated as
`ArchChan`. The free strict SMC's object language is then built over `ArchChan`.

```agda
data ArchChan : Set where
  TBD TBD-SYNC RECOVERY-P5 READ-STATE JUBJUB-SCHNORR STATE WITNESS-IPC User : ArchChan

module HA = FSM.FreeMonoidalHelper Symm ArchChan; open HA
```

## 2. Morphism generators: exactly the boxes of `architecture`

The morphism generators are the architecture's components — one `ArchBox`
constructor per box, indexed by its domain and codomain object-terms. Restricting
the generators to exactly these boxes is what makes `C_arch` *the* free category
of the architecture (rather than of arbitrary named morphisms).

```agda
data ArchBox : ObjTerm → ObjTerm → Set where
  didContract     : ArchBox unit (Var TBD)
  nameService     : ArchBox unit (Var TBD)
  peerDevices     : ArchBox unit (Var TBD-SYNC)
  recoveryHelpers : ArchBox unit (Var RECOVERY-P5)
  indexer         : ArchBox unit (Var READ-STATE)
  accountCustody  : ArchBox (Var TBD ⊗₀ Var TBD) (Var JUBJUB-SCHNORR)
  localWallet     : ArchBox (Var TBD-SYNC) (Var STATE)
  proofServer     : ArchBox unit (Var WITNESS-IPC)
  passportKey     : ArchBox
                      ( Var RECOVERY-P5 ⊗₀ Var READ-STATE ⊗₀ Var JUBJUB-SCHNORR
                      ⊗₀ Var STATE ⊗₀ Var WITNESS-IPC )
                      ( Var User )

open HA.Mor ArchBox
```

## 3. `architecture`, rebuilt in `C_arch`

The architecture itself is a single morphism `unit → User` in `C_arch`: three
layers composed left-to-right, each a tensor of boxes.

```agda
opaque
  unfolding ObjTerm _⊗₀_ unit Var

  architectureᶜ : HomTerm unit (Var User)
  architectureᶜ =
      var passportKey
    ∘ (    var recoveryHelpers ⊗₁ var indexer ⊗₁ var accountCustody
        ⊗₁ var localWallet     ⊗₁ var proofServer )
    ∘ ( var didContract ⊗₁ var nameService ⊗₁ var peerDevices )
```

## 4. Syntax functor `C_arch → FMTerm`

The object part is `chanName`; the morphism part is `synBox`, sending each box to
the correspondingly-named `gen`. Since the two categories have different object
generators (`ArchChan` vs `String`), the functor `syn` transports the object
indices through `chanName` — the `map-++` rewrites discharge that `chanName`
distributes over the tensor. `architectureˢ` is the image of `architectureᶜ`; it
is the term the diagram above is rendered from.

```agda
chanName : ArchChan → String
chanName TBD            = "TBD"
chanName TBD-SYNC       = "TBD SYNC"
chanName RECOVERY-P5    = "RECOVERY-P5"
chanName READ-STATE     = "READ STATE"
chanName JUBJUB-SCHNORR = "JUBJUB SCHNORR"
chanName STATE          = "STATE"
chanName WITNESS-IPC    = "WITNESS-IPC"
chanName User           = "User"

opaque
  unfolding ObjTerm _⊗₀_ unit Var

  Φ : ObjTerm → FM.ObjTerm
  Φ = map chanName

  synBox : ∀ {A B} → ArchBox A B → FM.HomTerm (Φ A) (Φ B)
  synBox didContract     = FM.gen "Midnight DID contract"   FM.unit (FM.Var "TBD")
  synBox nameService     = FM.gen "Name Service"            FM.unit (FM.Var "TBD")
  synBox peerDevices     = FM.gen "+ peer devices"          FM.unit (FM.Var "TBD SYNC")
  synBox recoveryHelpers = FM.gen "Recovery helpers"        FM.unit (FM.Var "RECOVERY-P5")
  synBox indexer         = FM.gen "Indexer"                 FM.unit (FM.Var "READ STATE")
  synBox accountCustody  = FM.gen "Account custody contract"
                             (FM.Var "TBD" FM.⊗₀ FM.Var "TBD") (FM.Var "JUBJUB SCHNORR")
  synBox localWallet     = FM.gen "Local wallet storage"    (FM.Var "TBD SYNC") (FM.Var "STATE")
  synBox proofServer     = FM.gen "Proof server"            FM.unit (FM.Var "WITNESS-IPC")
  synBox passportKey     = FM.gen "Passport Key"
                             ( FM.Var "RECOVERY-P5" FM.⊗₀ FM.Var "READ STATE" FM.⊗₀ FM.Var "JUBJUB SCHNORR"
                             FM.⊗₀ FM.Var "STATE" FM.⊗₀ FM.Var "WITNESS-IPC" )
                             ( FM.Var "User" )

  syn : ∀ {A B} → HomTerm A B → FM.HomTerm (Φ A) (Φ B)
  syn (var b)                  = synBox b
  syn id                       = FM.id
  syn (g ∘ f)                  = syn g FM.∘ syn f
  syn (_⊗₁_ {A} {B} {C} {D} f g)
    rewrite map-++ chanName A C | map-++ chanName B D = syn f FM.⊗₁ syn g
  syn λ⇒                       = FM.λ⇒
  syn λ⇐                       = FM.λ⇐
  syn (ρ⇒ {A}) rewrite map-++ chanName A [] = FM.ρ⇒
  syn (ρ⇐ {A}) rewrite map-++ chanName A [] = FM.ρ⇐
  syn (α⇒ {A} {B} {C})
    rewrite map-++ chanName (A ⊗₀ B) C | map-++ chanName A B
          | map-++ chanName A (B ⊗₀ C) | map-++ chanName B C = FM.α⇒ {Φ A} {Φ B} {Φ C}
  syn (α⇐ {A} {B} {C})
    rewrite map-++ chanName A (B ⊗₀ C) | map-++ chanName B C
          | map-++ chanName (A ⊗₀ B) C | map-++ chanName A B = FM.α⇐ {Φ A} {Φ B} {Φ C}
  syn (σ {A} {B} ⦃ i ⦄)
    rewrite map-++ chanName A B | map-++ chanName B A = FM.σ {Φ A} {Φ B} ⦃ i ⦄

  architectureˢ : FM.HomTerm FM.unit (FM.Var "User")
  architectureˢ = syn architectureᶜ
```

## 5. Semantics interpretation: generators → Machine

The semantics is given as generator data: a `Channel` per channel and a `Machine`
per box. A `ChannelModel` fixes the objects (and lifts them to the functor's
object map `⟦_⟧₀`); a `MachineModel` fixes the machines and reads them off as the
morphism map `⟦_⟧₁ : ArchBox → Machine`. Together they are the data of a
symmetric monoidal functor `C_arch → Machine`.

```agda
-- Lift a per-channel assignment to a Channel over the whole object term.
opaque
  unfolding ObjTerm _⊗₀_ unit Var

  objChannels : (ArchChan → Ch.Channel) → ObjTerm → Ch.Channel
  objChannels f []       = Ch.I
  objChannels f (x ∷ xs) = f x Ch.⊗₀ objChannels f xs

record ChannelModel : Set₁ where
  field
    ⟦TBD⟧            : Ch.Channel
    ⟦TBD-SYNC⟧       : Ch.Channel
    ⟦RECOVERY-P5⟧    : Ch.Channel
    ⟦READ-STATE⟧     : Ch.Channel
    ⟦JUBJUB-SCHNORR⟧ : Ch.Channel
    ⟦STATE⟧          : Ch.Channel
    ⟦WITNESS-IPC⟧    : Ch.Channel
    ⟦User⟧           : Ch.Channel

  channelSemantics : ArchChan → Ch.Channel
  channelSemantics TBD            = ⟦TBD⟧
  channelSemantics TBD-SYNC       = ⟦TBD-SYNC⟧
  channelSemantics RECOVERY-P5    = ⟦RECOVERY-P5⟧
  channelSemantics READ-STATE     = ⟦READ-STATE⟧
  channelSemantics JUBJUB-SCHNORR = ⟦JUBJUB-SCHNORR⟧
  channelSemantics STATE          = ⟦STATE⟧
  channelSemantics WITNESS-IPC    = ⟦WITNESS-IPC⟧
  channelSemantics User           = ⟦User⟧

  -- the functor's action on objects
  ⟦_⟧₀ : ObjTerm → Ch.Channel
  ⟦_⟧₀ = objChannels channelSemantics

record MachineModel : Set₁ where
  field
    channels : ChannelModel
  open ChannelModel channels public
  field
    ⟦didContract⟧     : Mc.Machine ⟦ unit ⟧₀ ⟦ Var TBD ⟧₀
    ⟦nameService⟧     : Mc.Machine ⟦ unit ⟧₀ ⟦ Var TBD ⟧₀
    ⟦peerDevices⟧     : Mc.Machine ⟦ unit ⟧₀ ⟦ Var TBD-SYNC ⟧₀
    ⟦recoveryHelpers⟧ : Mc.Machine ⟦ unit ⟧₀ ⟦ Var RECOVERY-P5 ⟧₀
    ⟦indexer⟧         : Mc.Machine ⟦ unit ⟧₀ ⟦ Var READ-STATE ⟧₀
    ⟦accountCustody⟧  : Mc.Machine ⟦ Var TBD ⊗₀ Var TBD ⟧₀ ⟦ Var JUBJUB-SCHNORR ⟧₀
    ⟦localWallet⟧     : Mc.Machine ⟦ Var TBD-SYNC ⟧₀ ⟦ Var STATE ⟧₀
    ⟦proofServer⟧     : Mc.Machine ⟦ unit ⟧₀ ⟦ Var WITNESS-IPC ⟧₀
    ⟦passportKey⟧     : Mc.Machine
                          ⟦ Var RECOVERY-P5 ⊗₀ Var READ-STATE ⊗₀ Var JUBJUB-SCHNORR
                          ⊗₀ Var STATE ⊗₀ Var WITNESS-IPC ⟧₀
                          ⟦ Var User ⟧₀

  -- The functor from the box generators into the category of machines,
  -- reading each box off its field.
  ⟦_⟧₁ : ∀ {A B} → ArchBox A B → Mc.Machine ⟦ A ⟧₀ ⟦ B ⟧₀
  ⟦ didContract     ⟧₁ = ⟦didContract⟧
  ⟦ nameService     ⟧₁ = ⟦nameService⟧
  ⟦ peerDevices     ⟧₁ = ⟦peerDevices⟧
  ⟦ recoveryHelpers ⟧₁ = ⟦recoveryHelpers⟧
  ⟦ indexer         ⟧₁ = ⟦indexer⟧
  ⟦ accountCustody  ⟧₁ = ⟦accountCustody⟧
  ⟦ localWallet     ⟧₁ = ⟦localWallet⟧
  ⟦ proofServer     ⟧₁ = ⟦proofServer⟧
  ⟦ passportKey     ⟧₁ = ⟦passportKey⟧
```
